name: LEEF (QRadar)
description: Receive events in Log Event Extended Format from QRadar and compatible tools

setup_guide.title: Forward LEEF events from QRadar
steps: In QRadar, go to Admin → Log Sources → Add
Configure a forwarding destination using HTTP/HTTPS
Set the target URL to the Hakuna webhook URL below
Select LEEF as the output format and include the Bearer token

sample_payload: LEEF:2.0|IBM|QRadar|1.0|EVT001|src=10.0.0.5	dst=10.0.0.6	sev=high	cat=Authentication	devTime=2024-03-15T14:30:00Z	usrName=admin	msg=Multiple failed login attempts detected
